primary_sources.title: Stacks Lemma54.4.3
primary_sources.used_statement: Resolve a rational map from a regular surface to a proper scheme by point blowups outside its existing domain; apply outside N.

primary_sources.title: Stacks Lemma54.17.1
primary_sources.used_statement: A proper birational morphism between regular surfaces factors as point blowups. Retained leaves and volume-order induction are proved in the new note, not imported from this lemma.

primary_sources.title: Allen Hatcher, Notes on Basic 3-Manifold Topology
primary_sources.used_statement: Standard Seifert construction: circle bundle over punctured base, section/peripheral coordinates, exceptional solid-torus attachments. The new integral handle quotient, arbitrary filling survival, fibre-orbit genus formula and companion permutation-tree proof are written in PF69.

primary_sources.title: Cochran--Tanner, Homology cobordism and Seifert fibered 3-manifolds, requested arXiv v1 PDF
primary_sources.used_statement: Section3 circle-bundle model and explicit orientable fundamental-group presentation, abelianized and quotiented by regular fibre and boundary loops in the new proof. No homology-cobordism or linking-realizability theorem imported.
